svg.title: Gradient boosting probability calibration results
svg.desc: The left panel compares uncalibrated and sigmoid-calibrated probabilities with the perfect-calibration diagonal. The right panel compares both probability distributions across 750 test devices.
A reliability diagram compares raw and sigmoid-calibrated probabilities with the perfect-calibration diagonal. A second panel compares the two probability distributions.

cc:Work.dc:title: Gradient boosting probability calibration results
cc:Work.dc:description: Reliability diagram and probability histograms for uncalibrated and sigmoid-calibrated classifiers.
